audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer graded this HARD at 8/10 and handed Diana all seven level-chart rows, while the packet chart, every content win[] row, and a 55.3% win rate over 434 games all say Brand wins the lane outright. The full-layer whys already described Brand winning the same rows they were assigned to Diana.
audit.why: Diana is melee with a 900-range skillshot and an 825-range dash that is only free against a Moonlight-marked target. Brand pokes from 1050 and clears with W-E. There is no phase where she takes the lane on cooldowns alone.
audit.corrected: All seven sides moved to Brand, ratings brought down, difficulty regraded TRICKY 6/10 with Diana's carry threat left at 8.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text called Crescent Strike a 'melee-range Q'.
audit.why: Crescent Strike is 900 range on an 8/7.5/7/6.5/6 cooldown. The spike that matters is that Lunar Rush has no cooldown against a Moonlight-marked target, so a dodged Q leaves her dash on 22 seconds at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around the real ranges and the Lunar Rush reset condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: Pale Cascade was never mentioned anywhere on the page, and wants.foe[2] claimed Lunar Rush resets off kills.
audit.why: Pale Cascade is a 15/13.5/12/10.5/9 shield that grows if the third sphere detonates, and it eats the front of a Brand rotation — the exact reason a greedy W into a fresh shield loses the trade. Lunar Rush resets off Moonlight marks, not kills, and applying Lunar Rush strips Moonlight from every other enemy.
audit.corrected: Shield stated in breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[2].d; wants.foe[2] corrected to Moonlight marks.

audit.why: It is the field that carries the numbers.
audit.corrected: Crescent Strike 8s, Lunar Rush 22s, Pale Cascade 15s and Moonfall's 475 range now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen lintFindings: Diana called he/his in winCon, tradeBad, phases[0].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dontsFull[0].t, dontsFull[2].t/.d and reports 1/3/4/11, plus dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d pasted from tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Diana is she/her per champ-gender.js; a bullet body must match its title.
audit.corrected: All fixed in the edits below.

audit.whatIsWrong: Brand's W carries a derived 'terrain' flag.
audit.why: Riot's Pillar of Flame description is delayed area damage only; it does not create terrain and cannot block Lunar Rush. Flag treated as a parsing misfire.
audit.corrected: No claim written that W stops her dash.
